Palermo noun

classical

Plin. 3.90 (Lewis & Short)
M-O s.v. Palermo
Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Palermo: Panormus

Panormus, Panormī f.

noun, second declension

Also Panhormus and neuter Panormum (Lewis & Short). A town takes no preposition: Panormum (to), Panormī (in, at), Panormō (from).

Other words

  • Panormitānus, Panormitāna, Panormitānum — of Palermo

    declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. Panormus

See also Italy, Sicily.
